Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size of the hemisphere. Larger values increase the radius and footprint of the shape on the terrain.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation of the hemisphere, determining how tall the dome rises above the base level.

Name: X
Description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the hemisphere along the X axis, allowing you to move it left or right within the terrain.

Name: Y
Description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the hemisphere along the Y axis, allowing you to move it forward or backward within the terrain.

Name: Flatten
Description: Flattens the top of the hemisphere, creating a dome with a plateau or truncated appearance instead of a perfect curve.
